# ScrapeGraphAI

ScrapeGraphAI is an AI-powered web scraping API that enables developers to extract structured data from any website using natural language prompts. Website https://scrapegraphai.com

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/scrapegraph-ai/.

## Actions

- **Get Credits** (read-only): Retrieve remaining and used credits for your scrapegraphai account.
- **Markdownify Status** (read-only): Check status and results of webpage-to-markdown conversion jobs.
- **Search Scraper** (read-only): Perform ai-powered web searches with structured, parsed results.
- **SmartCrawler Status** (read-only): Check status and results of smartcrawler web crawling jobs.
- **SmartScraper Status** (read-only): Check status and results of smartscraper web scraping jobs.
- **Start Smart Crawler**: Start ai-powered web crawling with structured data extraction across multiple pages.
- **Start Smart Scraper**: Start ai-powered web scraping with natural language extraction prompts.
- **Check SearchScraper Status** (read-only): Check the status and results of an asynchronous searchscraper job.
- **Convert Webpage to Markdown**: Convert a specified webpage into clean, formatted markdown.
- **Submit Feedback**: Submit feedback and ratings for completed scrapegraphai requests.
